Mainframe Modernization is a Hard and Fun Problem to Solve

Hypercubic is an agentic AI platform for mainframe operations and modernization, serving enterprises and governments that run the world's most critical mainframe infrastructure. Hypercubic helps organizations understand, operate and transform that infrastructure at a fraction of the timeline and cost compared to traditional modernization methods.

Today's top enterprises and governments trust Hypercubic to transform their critical mainframe infrastructure. Hypercubic serves organizations across financial services, insurance, government, manufacturing, defense, airlines, telecommunications, healthcare, oil and gas, logistics, retail and utilities.

Hypercubic runs entirely inside a customer's VPC or on-premise environment. Hypercubic operates with zero data egress, immutable audit trails and no model training on customer data, using the customer's own model and keys.
Hypercubic deploys to AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle and IBM cloud platforms. Hypercubic can be deployed in customer-controlled VPC or on-premise environments.

Hypercubic addresses six mainframe use cases across enterprises and governments: tribal knowledge preservation, verified mainframe transformation, legacy system understanding, business logic extraction, mainframe operations continuity and expert knowledge capture.
How does Hypercubic approach institutional knowledge preservation?
Hypercubic preserves institutional knowledge by combining what exists in the codebase with what only experienced operators know.

HyperDocs analyzes COBOL and related mainframe assets to create searchable documentation of programs, data flows, dependencies, and business logic. HyperTwin captures subject-matter expert knowledge through guided interviews and operational workflows, including how teams diagnose failures, run critical processes, and handle exceptions.
Together, they turn undocumented code and retiring-expert knowledge into a durable, searchable system of record that can support operations, onboarding, and modernization.
See how Hypercubic transforms critical mainframe infrastructure — preserving expertise, modernizing COBOL, and accelerating delivery for the systems that run your business.
